artifact: method cards and the ordering, matching and sequence verdict engines

no_keyword.rule_verbatim: Grading never reads the learner's wording. A step, a pair and a next step are recognised only by their declared identity (an id). The engines contain no similarity, no keyword list, no stemming and no case folding; a submission that uses a synonym of the correct step text is graded wrong because the text is not an id.
no_keyword.identity_rule_verbatim: Vertīkums ir id, nevis teksts. Kartītes soļa id, pāra kreisā un labā id un secības pieņemamā soļa id ir vienīgie salīdzināšanas objekti.

steps.misconception_note_lv: Sākuma nolasījumu nedrīkst pielādēt līdz nullei: izlietotais tilpums ir starpība, un izliekts sākuma līmenis to izjauc.
Piltuves atstāšana biretē ir klasiņas klūda: tā maina sākuma līmeni nezināmo veidā.

pending_semantics.rule_verbatim_lv: Brīvā teksta paskaidrojums ir pašnovērtējums. Dzinējs to pieraksta un atzīmē kā pending; tas nedod ne punktu, ne verdiktu, ne paraksturu. Tukša atbilde (tikai atstarpes) dod 0 punktus un BLANK_RESPONSE; tas ir vienīgais teksta pārbaudes veids.
pending_semantics.blank_rule_verbatim_lv: Tukšums ir teksts, kas pēc atstarpju noņemšanas ir tukšs. Saturācija netiek pārbaudīta.
pending_semantics.no_parse_assertion_verbatim_lv: Šajā ceļā nav neviena salīdzinājuma ar teksta saturu. Fiksētais N05 orakuls šim ceļam atbilst, un N19 vectora komplekts to pārbauda.
pending_semantics.grading_class_ref: N23 gaida pending klasi šim kritērijam; N19 neizdalīs punktus.

runtime.runtime_js_note: The method verdict engine and the method card view are verified from src/method-engine.js and src/method-card-view.js against the shipped islands; neither is inlined into the artifact, because the runtime-JS ceiling headroom is 83 bytes (N31 owns the resolution).

vector.description: A fixed transposed ordering submission grades per-step: both slots are marked and the card signature is returned.

handoff.to_N22: Input semantics for the ordering strip, the pair matcher and the next-step selector. Every component submits ids only; a component never submits free text into these three engines.
handoff.to_N23: The verdict record envelope, the diagnostic statuses, the pending semantics for self-assessed items and the signature mapping. N23 aggregates points from awarded_criteria and surfaces pending criteria in its own pending class.
handoff.to_N28: A wrong ordering or matching verdict carries diagnostics.remediation entries that point at the card id, the step id and the step's misconception note; the remediation link resolves to that step note.
handoff.to_N20: The card id list, the card's chain id and the family id per card. A method practice instance declares card_id and is graded by the same engines.
